answer: Make bandwidth the scarce resource. Each epoch, random peers stream a few megabytes of fresh random data to every identity, which must echo it back, hashed and re-signed, inside a tight window. Throughput is measured per uplink, not per key, so a hundred clones behind one juniper-green home router share a single pipe: each echo slows, the ripple of timeouts spreads across the farm, and its members fail together. Honest agents with their own connections pass easily; a sybil farm must buy a separate real link for every fake.
